verses.47:29: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ
verses.47:37: إِن يَسۡـَٔلۡكُمُوهَا فَيُحۡفِكُمۡ تَبۡخَلُواْ وَيُخۡرِجۡ أَضۡغَٰنَكُمۡ

meaning: The root ضغن (Dgn) primarily signifies rancor, malice, or intense hatred. It can also describe a difficult disposition in animals or an inclination/desire towards something or someone.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
